summary: Wavelet coherence confirms NH-SH albedo coupling at interannual (ENSO-band) and annual timescales. SH leads NH by ~4 months at ENSO periods. H003 now has 2/3 methods confirming. Key insight: coupling is strongest at ENSO-related periods, suggesting tropical Pacific may mediate hemispheric albedo symmetry.
